excerpts.text: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

Void Shift
STATIC COOLDOWN:
30 / 24 / 18 / 12 (based on level)
Innate: Periodically, Malzahar gains Void Shift until he takes non- minion damage or negates a crowd control effect, to which it then lingers for a brief time before expiring. Void Shift's cooldown refreshes whenever Malzahar takes non- minion damage or is affected by a crowd control effect. Void Shift: Malzahar gains crowd control immunity and massive damage reduction.
Innate: Periodically, Malzahar gains Void Shift until he takes non- minion damage or negates a crowd control effect, to which it then lingers for 0.25 seconds before expiring. Void Shift: Malzahar gains crowd control immunity and reduces incoming damage from non-minions by 90%.
Void Shift's cooldown refreshes whenever Malzahar takes non- minion damage or is affected by a crowd control effect, and resets upon respawning.

NOTICE TO API USERS:Damage classifications are being amended across the League of Legends Wiki and also being refactored into the "Damage Info" tab.
Void Shift will not resist allied crowd control nor will it be deactivated by them.
Void Shift will not mitigate true damage but the buff will still be consumed.
It does not deactivate against the Nexus Obelisk.
Shields will take priority over Void Shift, but the buff is always consumed, even if the shield fully mitigates the damage. (bug)
However, if Malzahar has a spell shield and is hit by an effect that isn't negated by the spell shield, then if the shield fully mitigates the damage, Void Shift will not be consumed.
Spell shields take priority over Void Shift for abilities that contain a crowd control effect.
Void Shift will specifically not deactivate if Malzahar eats Honeyfruit or is within a hostile Frozen Heart passive aura.
Void Shift does not prevent Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble's trap drowsy. [1] (unexpected)
Void Shift is special cased to prevent Fizz's Chum the Waters, and Thresh's Death Sentence from attaching to Malzahar.

As long as the target is within the tether radius, they will take the full tether damage over 2.5 seconds even if they are not tethered due to the tether being broken early into the channel.(bug)
This occurs regardless of how the tether was broken.
If the target exits tether range they will stop taking damage, but can be damaged again by the remaining ticks if they re-enter the tether range within the duration.
Removing the suppression will also remove the reveal.
Malzahar places himself onto the ground and interrupts displacements affecting him upon starting the channel.
If a target is currently being affected by Malefic Visions, casting Nether Grasp on them will grant 2 stacks toward effects such as Electrocute.(bug)
This is, correctly, not the case if Nether Grasp is cast before Malefic Visions.

A zealous seer dedicated to the unification of all life, Malzahar truly believes the newly emergent Void to be the path to Runeterra’s salvation. In the desert wastes of Shurima, he followed the voices that whispered in his mind, all the way to ancient Icathia. Amidst the ruins of that land, he gazed into the dark heart of the Void itself, and was gifted new power and purpose. Malzahar now sees himself as a shepherd, empowered to bring others into the fold… or to release the voidling creatures that dwell beneath.
Vic Mignogna
